picks.headline: OpenAI lowers GPT-5.6 pricing for Luna and Terra tiers
picks.why: Reduces API costs for enterprise agent and workflow deployments using OpenAI's latest frontier tier.
picks.title: Advancing the price-performance frontier with GPT-5.6

picks.headline: Hollow-LLM attack bypasses zero-knowledge LLM inference verification
picks.why: Demonstrates that untrusted inference providers can generate valid ZK proofs while computing on cheap ghost weights rather than actual models.
picks.title: Hollow-LLM Attack: Computationally Trivial Weights in Zero-Knowledge Verification of LLM Inference

picks.headline: All eight major open-source AI skill scanners fail against real-world attacks
picks.why: Reveals that current static and dynamic open-source scanners provide false security when auditing third-party agent tools.
picks.title: A hole in every one: bypassing the open source AI skill scanners

picks.headline: GradLock attack embeds secret training data directly into open-source model parameters
picks.why: Enables malicious model providers to covertly exfiltrate private training datasets through open model weights.
picks.title: Don't Trust the AI Ecosystem: Analyzing Privacy Leakage in Compromised Open-Source Components

picks.headline: DeltaServe co-serves LLM inference and LoRA fine-tuning without latency impact
picks.why: Reclaims idle GPU inference headroom for concurrent fine-tuning workloads while maintaining strict real-time SLOs.
picks.title: DeltaServe: Host-Agnostic Co-Serving of Inference and Fine-Tuning for LLMs

picks.headline: Sparse MoE expert-reduction ordering causes non-deterministic model output divergence
picks.why: Exposes a subtle numerical instability in MoE serving engines where mathematically equivalent reduction orders yield different behavioral outputs.
picks.title: From Expert Reduction to Behavioral Divergence: Tracing Numerical State through Sparse MoE Inference

picks.headline: Concurrent audio prompt injections hide malicious instructions inside human speech
picks.why: Introduces a novel zero-click injection attack vector against multimodal voice agents by masking commands within ambient background audio.
picks.title: Piggybacking on Perception: Stealthy Concurrent Audio Prompt Injections against Multimodal LLM Agents

papers.headline: CoMem caches lower LLM layers for efficient unbounded-context memory retrieval
papers.why: Exploits layer-depth division of labor in LLMs to dramatically reduce memory overhead by recomputing only upper layers.
papers.title: Understanding Is Done Early: A Depth Division of Labor in Large Language Models and Its Use for Unbounded-Context Memory

papers.headline: Entropy-based chain-of-thought compression performs no better than random pruning
papers.why: Disproves a popular design heuristic by showing reasoning information is distributed evenly across reasoning chains rather than concentrated in low-entropy tokens.
papers.title: Demystifying Entropy-based Selection for Chain-of-Thought Compression in Large Reasoning Models

papers.headline: LLM code editors systematically avoid deleting code, introducing wrapper anti-patterns
papers.why: Identifies a systematic flaw in AI coding agents that wrap targeted logic in guard conditions instead of performing clean line deletions.
papers.title: To Add Is Machine, To Delete Is Human: Measuring and Mitigating Deletion Avoidance in LLM Code Editing
